name: Video To Text
tagline: LinkToText LinkToText is a tool for turning video and audio into clean, reusable text
description: LinkToText LinkToText is a tool for turning video and audio into clean, reusable text. Users can paste a public media link or upload a file to generate a transcript. It supports content from platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, podcasts, and common audio or video formats such as MP3, MP4, WAV, MOV, MKV, and WebM.
